title: Structurally Diverse Phenolic Amides from the Fruits of Lycium barbarum with Potent alpha-Glucosidase, Dipeptidyl Peptidase-4 Inhibitory, and PPAR-gamma Agonistic Activities.
authors: Chen, Hui; Zhang, Wen-Jing; Kong, Jiang-Bo; Liu, Yun; Zhi, Yan-Le; Cao, Yan-Gang; Du, Kun; Xue, Gui-Min; Li, Meng; Zhao, Zhen-Zhu; Sun, Yan-Jun; Feng, Wei-Sheng; Xie, Zhi-Shen
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究枸杞果实中酚酰胺类化合物的分离鉴定及其对α-葡萄糖苷酶、DPP-4和PPAR-γ的抑制/激动活性，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A total of nine new phenolic amides (1-9), including four pairs of enantiomeric mixtures (3-5 and 8), along with ten known analogues (10-19) were identified from the fruits of Lycium barbarum using bioassay-guided chromatographic fractionation. Their structures were elucidated by comprehensive spectroscopic and spectrometric analyses, chiral HPLC analyses, and quantum NMR, and electronic circular dichroism calculations. Compounds 5-7 are the first example of feruloyl tyramine dimers fused through a cyclobutane ring. The activity results indicated that compounds 1, 11, and 13-17 exhibited remarkable inhibition against alpha-glucosidase with IC(50) of 1.11-33.53 muM, 5-150 times stronger than acarbose (IC(50) = 169.78 muM). Meanwhile, compounds 4a, 4b, 5a, 5b, 13, and 14 exerted moderate agonistic activities for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR-gamma), with EC(50) values of 10.09-44.26 muM. Especially,compound 14 also presented inhibitory activity on dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPPIV), with an IC(50) value of 47.13 muM. Furthermore, the banding manner of compounds 14 and 17 with the active site of alpha-glucosidase, DPPIV, and PPAR-gamma was explored by employing molecular docking analysis.
abstract_zh: 通过生物测定引导的色谱分离，从枸杞（Lycium barbarum）果实中共鉴定出九个新的酚酰胺类化合物（1-9），包括四对外消旋混合物（3-5和8），以及十个已知类似物（10-19）。其结构通过综合光谱和质谱分析、手性高效液相色谱分析、量子核磁共振及电子圆二色谱计算得以阐明。化合物5-7是首次发现的通过环丁烷环融合的阿魏酰酪胺二聚体。活性结果表明，化合物1、11和13-17对α-葡萄糖苷酶表现出显著抑制作用，其半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）为1.11-33.53 μM，比阿卡波糖（IC(50) = 169.78 μM）强5-150倍。同时，化合物4a、4b、5a、5b、13和14对过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR-γ）表现出中等激动活性，其半数有效浓度（EC(50)）值为10.09-44.26 μM。特别是，化合物14还对二肽基肽酶-4（DPPIV）表现出抑制活性，其IC(50)值为47.13 μM。此外，通过分子对接分析，探讨了化合物14和17与α-葡萄糖苷酶、DPPIV及PPAR-γ活性位点的结合方式。
